en.title: Record resident World3D geometry on Android
en.body: The Android recorder shares mesh definitions between acknowledged frames. Native playback can reconstruct a full frame on EGL recovery while keeping the existing 64 MiB recording limit and compatibility with earlier captures.

zh.title: Android 原生录像复用 World3D 驻留几何
zh.body: Android 录制器允许连续成功提交的帧共用网格定义。原生回放可在 EGL 恢复时重建完整帧，继续遵守 64 MiB 文件上限，并兼容已有录像。
